question: Which ritual path yields fruit through devotion to the goddess?
premises: The goddess is ever devoted in the left path
The right path is described as devoid of fruit
inference: Devotion in the left path is fruitful, while the right path lacks fruit.
uncertainties: The scope of fruitlessness for the right path may be context-specific
plain_english: Ever devoted in the left path, she is ever-present; the right path is devoid of fruit.
